
	bodyAttrs := func(w http.ResponseWriter) {
		writeBodyAttrOnVisibilityChange(w)
	}

	bodySuffix := func(w http.ResponseWriter) {

		_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `data-init="@get('`)
		if sess.UserID != "" {
			_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `/feed/_$/')"`)
		} else {
			_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `/feed/_$/anon/')"`)
		}
	}
